messages:
maya: heads up — spotted a cache-related regression after last runtime deploy. increased cross-tenant cache hit-rate in prod on kv-store. could be cache keying logic; attaching quick profiler + logs. https://internal.g/gh/encache/trace-1743210000 :eyes:

sanjay: can you paste repro steps or the key-generation snippet?

maya: repro is simple, local replay of common prompt shapes shows hits across different tenant ids. keying code we ship looks like:
```
const key = sha256(promptFingerprint)  // older code — no tenant prefix
// saved into shared kv: redis/hotcache
```
logs: `cache_key=3f6a... tenant=null hit=true` and then `user=tenant_b request=... matched cache_key=3f6a...`

eli: ran a perf profile — confirming. the hot path is in prefix-cache module. heap dump shows many entries with key namespace missing. hit-rate curve for tenant_a and tenant_b overlapped starting at 2025-06-12T02:14Z (post-deploy). attaching flamegraph gist: https://internal.g/fg/1743210000

kira: big red flag for tenant isolation + data leakage. even if payloads are non-sensitive, prompts could contain PII. we need immediate mitigations:
- ensure namespace/tenant id is incorporated into cache keys
- consider HMAC(key_material, tenant_secret) instead of plain prefix to avoid enumeration
- audit which customers might have been served other tenants' cached outputs

roma: short-term mitigation I can push ASAP: prefix cache keys with tenant id at the API edge and issue a targeted eviction run for the last 48h entries. will also throttle the batch-warmup job that might be seeding shared keys.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] recommended action: rollback runtime release `r-2025.06.12`? 

maya: rollback would stop ongoing leakage but we'll lose other fixes. prefer fast patch + purge if patch can be deployed in 30-45m.

eli: agreed — patch plan:
1) change keying to `hmac(tenant_secret, promptFingerprint)` and include tenant id as metadata (non-searchable)
2) add unit/integration tests that assert cross-tenant keys never collide for >100k synthetic prompts
3) run a read-only scan to list keys without tenant component and generate impact list

sanjay: I'll own the code change + tests. I'll use the secrets from vault: `kv/tenant-salts/*`. implementation note: keep HMAC output truncated to 24 bytes to keep key length stable and avoid redis memory blowup. will also add a feature-flag for gradual rollout.

kira: audit asks for an entry in the compliance log with affected customer IDs and time window. also require evidence of patch + purge before closing. we should not assume encryption at rest prevents this — this is logical leakage.

audit-bot: created ticket INFSEC-3421; assigned to @sanjay and @roma. deadline: 2025-06-12T23:59Z.

roma: eviction plan: run a Redis SCAN for keys matching legacy pattern (sha256 only) and delete in batches of 1000; I'll track progress in the runbook. also add a short-circuit in the cache read path: if stored metadata tenant != request.tenant then treat as miss and increment audit counter.

maya: add to postmortem: why tenant prefix was removed in the refactor — looks like a reverted diff in PR #876 had the change. need better code review checks and unit tests.

eli: follow-ups: add e2e perf test to ensure warmup jobs don't accidentally populate shared cache with disparate tenants. and add telemetry: per-tenant cache collision counter + alert if > 0 for 5m.

sanjay: starting PR now. will post link when ready, and request a hotfix review.

maya: thanks all. timeline: patch in 45m, purge in 60m, audit impact list within 3h. will spin up a tiny cross-team war room in #eng-security if needed. :lock:
